purpose: Parameterize the annual implementation resources that accompany the final nine-climate service, energy, carbon and flexibility results.
costs_are: Analyst-declared sensitivity inputs, not observed deployment costs and not estimates for the nine simulated climates.
wages_include: Wages only; employer benefits, overhead, taxes and local price conversion are not added.
common_cost_rule: Only explicitly declared incremental resources enter the sensitivity. Existing building equipment and upstream archived observations are not repriced.
population_rule: Feedback counts are additional responses per building-year. They are scenario inputs and are not inferred from the 267 simulated profiles.
hardware_rule: The primary boundary adds no hardware. The optional interface input does not represent physical rezoning and has no attributed energy or service benefit.
break_even_rule: For local electricity price p_e and gas price p_g, the minimum combined annual service and response value is max(0, annual implementation cost + delta electricity times p_e + delta gas times p_g).
